metaDescription: Order custom sublimation badges for vibrant, all-over color. Perfect for ID badges and event credentials. Bulk pricing at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows full-color, edge-to-edge designs on polyester-coated badges, making them ideal for photo IDs, security credentials, and event passes where crisp images and logos are essential. Unlike traditional imprint methods, sublimation dyes bond directly with the material, producing durable, fade-resistant badges that won't peel or crack. For marketing directors and HR managers needing high-volume, professional-looking badges with complex graphics or photographic elements, sublimation delivers unmatched detail and color vibrancy.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation badges with full-color printing, ideal for employee ID badges and event credentials.
